podcasts.title: Get It Again
podcasts.description: Get It Again is taking a look back at WCW Thunder! Wrestling insiders Andrea Listenberger, Smackdown writer, Andrew Krukowski, former Lucha Underground writer, and Matt Mazany, former Raw and NXT writer, and host Stephen Loh partake in a journey to rewatch all 156 episodes of Thunder and discuss all the would'ves, could'ves, should'ves, and what-ifs of WCW's infamous B-show.
